# Q1 · Make an automated recommendation system for the PicCollage mobile app.
### (c) Scenario C: Create a diagonal set of random points trending upwards at 45 degrees.
```{R}
#pts_C <- interactive_regression()
#saveRDS(pts_C, "pts_C.rds")
pts_C <- readRDS("pts_C.rds")

plot(pts_C$x, pts_C$y, pch = 19,
     main = "Scenario C: Positive trend",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "y")

abline(lm(pts_C$y ~ pts_C$x), col = "purple")

cor(pts_C)
summary(lm(pts_C$y ~ pts_C$x))
```
